tool_schemas.name: vibe_check
tool_schemas.description: Evaluates the provided in-progress plan or implementation text for a given workspace/session and records a vibe_check run (including the input_text, optional context, and the tool’s findings) on that session, returning the newly created run with its analysis output. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id or session_id do not match the required vbc_wsp_/vbc_sess_ formats, if required fields are missing, or if unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the workspace or session; raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace or session does not exist (or the session is not in the workspace); and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace/run limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the session and tool run.

session_id.description: Session id to attach this vibe_check run to.

input_text.description: The in-progress plan or implementation text to evaluate.

context.description: Optional structured context to store on the session or alongside the run request.

tool_schemas.name: vibe_distill
tool_schemas.description: Distills the provided plan or implementation text for a given workspace/session into a simplified distilled plan, records a vibe_distill run on the session, and returns the run along with the created distilled plan (including any optional notes you provide). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id or session_id do not match the required vbc_wsp_/vbc_sess_ formats, if required fields are missing, or if unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the workspace or session; raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced workspace or session does not exist (or the session is not in the workspace); raises CONFLICT if the session is not in a state that can accept a new distillation run; and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace/run or distilled-plan limits are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the session, run, and distilled plan.

session_id.description: Session id to attach this vibe_distill run (and resulting distilled plan) to.

input_text.description: The plan or implementation text to simplify and distill.

notes.description: Optional notes to save onto the resulting distilled plan.

tool_schemas.name: vibe_learn
tool_schemas.description: Pattern recognition system that tracks common errors and solutions to prevent recurring issues

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the session, run, and learned patterns.

session_id.description: Session id to attach this vibe_learn run to.

input_text.description: Text describing what went wrong and/or what was fixed, used to extract reusable patterns.

tags.description: Optional tags to associate with any patterns learned from this run.

tool_schemas.name: list_sessions
tool_schemas.description: Lists sessions in a workspace with optional filtering by status and time. Returns a paginated list of session records the caller is authorized to read; refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the caller lacks access to the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose sessions to list.

status.description: If provided, only return sessions in this status.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive substring match against session title.

opened_after.description: If provided, only return sessions opened at or after this timestamp.

opened_before.description: If provided, only return sessions opened at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Field to sort by for pagination stability.

tool_schemas.name: create_session
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new session in the given workspace and returns the created session. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or required fields are missing, and with AUTH_ERROR if the caller is not permitted to create sessions in the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that will own the new session.

context.description: Optional structured context to persist on the session (e.g., repo, ticket, constraints).

status.description: Initial session status; may not be created as deleted.

tool_schemas.name: update_session
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing session (title/context and lifecycle status transitions) and returns the updated session. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist in the workspace, VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal status transitions, and AUTH_ERROR if the caller lacks permission.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the session.

context.description: New structured context to store on the session.

status.description: New status for the session. Transitions allowed: open->archived/deleted, archived->open/deleted; deleted is terminal and triggers cascade deletion of the session’s tool_runs and distilled_plans.

closed_at.description: Optional close timestamp. If provided, must be consistent with status (typically archived).

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_runs
tool_schemas.description: Lists tool runs in a workspace, optionally filtered by session, tool name, and status. Returns a paginated list of tool_run records; refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the caller lacks access to the workspace.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose tool runs to list.

session_id.description: If provided, only return runs belonging to this session.

tool_name.description: If provided, only return runs for this tool.

status.description: If provided, only return runs in this status.

created_after.description: If provided, only return runs created at or after this timestamp.

created_before.description: If provided, only return runs created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Field to sort by for pagination stability.

tool_schemas.name: get_tool_run
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool run by id within a workspace and returns the full record (including request/response payloads when available). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if no such run exists in the workspace and AUTH_ERROR if the caller lacks access.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that owns the tool run.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity, granted scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for this API key/session. Refuses with AUTH_ERROR if the presented credentials are missing or invalid.

api_key.description: Bearer credential used to authenticate the request, as issued by Vibe Check.
